title: Urth area
description: Optional metadata: data/world/<area>/area.yaml. The directory name is the area's id.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the directory name.

detached.description: Not meant to be reachable on foot or to place its prototypes by reset; the content check leaves it alone.

loot.description: Drawn for every mob of the area that dies, after the mob's own table: the area's farmed materials (docs/RULES.md 5.3).
